title: Horizontal Leg Press
summary: A seated selectorized leg press that pushes straight out. It's usually lighter than a 45-degree sled, with the back fully supported, but you can't go quite as deep.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.5 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.45 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.45 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Sit with your back flat on the pad and your feet shoulder width on the platform.
Bend your knees toward your chest as far as your hips allow.
Press out until your legs are almost straight.

form_cues.cue: Lower until knees are deeply bent
Keep your hips down on the seat at the bottom.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Heavier loading potential.
Swap sheet: One side at a time.
